rs.src: RS line = SNOW close ÷ SPY Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped-daily adjusted bars, RS cache feeds/rs/cache/grouped close on the same date (same data source as the chart bars; dates without a SPY close are skipped, never interpolated); shown in the bar tooltip. rating.label: IBD-style RS (our calc, not IBD's official rating)
rating.src: feeds/rs/latest.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py: raw = 2·ROC63 + ROC126 + ROC189 + ROC252, percentile 1-99; rank 1 = strongest)

hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA). A band switches only after the new state holds 2 sessions in a row; no band before the MA21 exists.
hist.src: RS rating history: feeds/rs/rating_history.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py; each session ranked from the Massive grouped-daily cache using only bars up to that session; only sessions with a full 252-session lookback). History for SNOW starts 2026-06-08 and ends 2026-10-02; nothing is drawn before it. Orange line = 21-session simple moving average of the rating (needs 21 consecutive rated sessions).
